material: [home] All-in-one finance platform for SMEs: invoicing, expenses, bookkeeping, accountant collaboration. [pricing] Starter 29 EUR/month, Pro 69 EUR/month, accountant seat 49 EUR. [changelog Oct] New: multi-entity consolidation, AI receipt capture. [jobs] Hiring 4 enterprise AEs in Paris. [reviews] "Great once set up; onboarding took three weeks." "Support slow in August."
our_context: Bookkeeping automation for multi-site restaurants in France, 40 customers, deciding whether to raise prices and whether to add invoicing
